fail_fact.title: Cybersecurity is still badly enforced
text: Even though the press is full of news on cybersecurity-related matters, the reality is that only few cybercriminals are ever caught and prosecuted.
This is a clear indication that better coordination would be needed, in both EU and international levels. Perhaps there should be a new intergovernmental agency?
